rules.accepted_credit_types: CME credits; NCCPA maintenance of certification (incl. at least 60 CME credits in 3 years); emeritus volunteer clinical service; Board consultant service (1 h per 2 h, max 20/yr)
rules.alternatives: Exempt: certified or recertified by NCCPA within the past 3 years as of renewal; inactive license.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for PAs who have held a Wyoming license less than 3 years at the renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Verify on each annual renewal; random audit of about 10% of PAs, documents due within 45 days; keep CME records at least 4 years.
rules.notes: Licenses renew every year by December 31; CME counted over the preceding 3 calendar years. Board posts an unofficial copy of the rules; official text on rules.wyo.gov.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Medicine Rules, Chapter 5, Sections 11, 12, 21
